Subject: Your breach of contract matter (Project Flamingo)

Dear Mr. Bose,

Thank you for meeting us on 23 April 2019 about your dispute with Orchid Logistics Ltd. As we understand it, the counterparty terminated the contract without notice. The matter is listed before the Vadodara Commercial Court.

Our advice is to send a notice of breach giving the cure period required by the contract. Please collect the contract, the termination letter and the board minutes and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
